note: Hiring & Onboarding → Onboarding Status. The checklist a new joiner (or a transferred-in employee) works through. SmartPRS 2 has these as PHP constants (DEFAULT_ITEMS, TRANSFER_ITEMS); here they are data, and a tenant's own list under `customisation_key` replaces them. A board's items are copied at the moment it starts, so changing the list later does not rewrite boards already in progress.
